## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] If data was added: source is cited in code comments
- [ ] If corpus build changed: `public/corpus/*.json` regenerated and included
- [ ] No personal config, local paths, or unrelated changes
- [ ] If new module: registered in `src/modules/registry.ts` and added to the
      sidebar group
- [ ] If new persisted state: localStorage key namespaced and documented
